breakdown.description: Steady Bernoulli is applied to a rapid transient (water hammer); unsteady compressibility/elasticity effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that applying the steady Bernoulli equation to a rapid transient event (water hammer) is incorrect. It replaced this flawed approach with the appropriate method, the Joukowsky water hammer equation (Δp = ρ × a × ΔV), which directly aligns with the correction made in the ground truth prompt.
